listening_material_parts.scenario: A traveller phones a hotel to book a family room, and the receptionist supplies the dates, rates, room details, facilities and booking reference.

turns.speaker: speaker1
turns.text: This is the IELTS Listening test. You will hear a number of different recordings, and you will have to answer questions on what you hear. There will be time for you to read the instructions and questions, and you will have a chance to check your work. All the recordings will be played once only. The test is in four parts. At the end of the test, you will be given ten minutes to transfer your answers to the answer sheet. Now turn to Part 1. Part 1. You will hear a man telephoning a hotel to book a room for his family. First, you have some time to look at questions 1 to 4. Now listen carefully and answer questions 1 to 4.

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: Good morning, Lakeview Hotel, reception. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: Good morning. I'm calling to book a room for a family holiday next month, and I'd like to check what you have available, please.

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: Of course, I'd be happy to help with that. Could I take your name, please, sir?

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: Yes, it's Carter, that's C-A-R-T-E-R.

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: Thank you, Mr Carter. And when were you thinking of staying with us?

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: Well, we were hoping to come in March, around the middle of the month, if you have anything free then. It's our first proper family holiday this year.

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: Let me have a look at the calendar. Which exact dates did you have in mind?

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: The 12th of March, arriving in the afternoon, if that's all right.

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: The 12th, that's fine, we do have rooms then. And how many people will the booking be for?

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: There'll be four of us — my wife, our two children and me.

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: Four guests, lovely, a family trip. And how long are you planning to stay?

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: Three nights, so we'd be checking out on the 15th.

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: The 15th of March, that's right, three nights altogether. Lovely, let me put all of that into the system for you.

turns.speaker: speaker1
turns.text: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions 5 to 10. Now listen and answer questions 5 to 10.

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: Before we go any further, could you tell me the nightly rate for a family room, please?

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: It's a hundred pounds a night... no, sorry, let me check that again — it's actually 95 pounds a night, not a hundred.

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: 95 pounds a night. That's very reasonable for four people. And is breakfast included in that price?

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: Yes, a full cooked breakfast is included for all four of you, every morning of your stay.

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: That's good to hear. And is a family room actually free for those nights?

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: Yes, we have a family room free for those nights. It's a good size, with a double bed and two single beds, so the children will have plenty of space of their own.

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: Perfect for us. And where will our room be in the hotel itself?

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: You'd be in Room 204, on the second floor. It's nice and quiet up there, well away from the road.

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: Lovely. And does the room look out over the lake or the car park?

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: Both are possible on that floor, so it's really up to you. The car park side is a little quieter in the mornings, I should say.

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: We'll take the lake view, definitely — the children will love looking out at the boats.

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: No problem at all. I'll make a note on the booking, so the one facing the water is yours.

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: Great. Now, one practical thing — is there Wi-Fi in the rooms? The children can't live without it.

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: There is, yes. It used to be £8 a day, but not any more — the Wi-Fi is free in every room now.

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: Oh, that's useful to know. And what other facilities does the hotel have for guests? We like to keep busy in the evenings.

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: Well, the sauna is open from seven in the morning till ten at night, and there's a small gym as well, if you're feeling energetic while you're here.

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: Wonderful. I think that's everything we need, then. My wife will be very pleased about the sauna.

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: In that case, let me give you your booking reference, so you have it ready for when you arrive. It's HB7K42 — that's H-B-7-K-4-2.

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: HB7K42. Got it, thank you. And that's everything confirmed for the 12th of March, is it?

turns.speaker: speaker2
turns.text: That's right, Mr Carter, everything is booked and confirmed for those three nights. We look forward to seeing you and your family then. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: speaker3
turns.text: Goodbye, and thanks again for all your help.

turns.speaker: speaker1
turns.text: That is the end of Part 1. You now have half a minute to check your answers to Part 1. Now turn to Part 2.
